set.body: Observed in exemplars/haxby2001: plan_geometry(relation, at=frame, over=over, metric=noise_precision(diag(n), ...)) makes rdm() take ~3 minutes over 577 VT centres versus 0.48 s for the identical plan without a metric, although R/metric.R:171-173 detects diag() as native_diagonal. An identity/diagonal metric should cost approximately nothing. Likely the metric path abandons the fused sparse contraction. Same contract constraints as bd-01KZYYQCR3D7NDZQN5DN53AHRC: exact estimand, plan identity unchanged.
set.title: rdm() with a domain-wide fixed metric is ~375x slower (3 min vs 0.48 s over 577 centres) even when the metric is detected native_diagonal
